objective: Bounded UE 5.8 Dublin flight-game destruction stage: clean prefractured buildings, geometric terrain craters with collision, local water simulation and effects, cannon and gravity bombs with game-only yield.

ownership.allowed_reads: Targeted installed-engine Chaos, GeometryCollection, FieldSystem, Niagara, ProceduralMesh, DynamicMesh and Water native source; official Epic web documentation.
not_performed: Editor calls or editor ownership changes
Builds, installs, downloads or executable code changes
Python, arbitrary reflection runners or replacement MCP servers
Delegation, issue filing or identity postings
Inspection of flight-agent or city-data-agent files

decisions.buildings: Cook offline/editor-prefractured Geometry Collection assets; instantiate native components and apply bounded local damage at runtime. Asset-wide destruction capability does not mean simultaneous city-wide active rigid bodies.
decisions.terrain: Use project-owned chunked deformable geometry and collision. No claim that stock Landscape supports the required packaged-runtime deformation.
decisions.water: Local reduced-order simulation patches plus bounded Niagara plumes; no full-river CFD claim.
decisions.yield: A dimensionless game tuning value only; no TNT mass, physical blast equations or real explosive recipes.
decisions.performance: 60 FPS is an unverified acceptance target on the specified laptop, conditional on resolution, renderer settings, concurrency and measured frame times.
decisions.authoring_tools: User reports no explicit GeometryCollection fracture toolset. PhysicsAsset and DataflowAgent availability alone does not establish automated fracture support. Use verified typed tools only, or a purpose-built native editor pipeline; no unrestricted execution bridge.
decisions.feasibility_verdict: Concrete native mechanisms exist for a bounded vertical slice. Unlimited simultaneous city destruction, literal arbitrary-resolution cutting, realistic full-river fluid mechanics and a guaranteed 60 FPS are not established.
decisions.scope_meaning: Every accepted building asset must support destruction down to authored pieces, while only a capped near-field set simulates at once. This is prefractured rigid-body destruction, not runtime cutting at arbitrary impact contours.

evidence.finding: Exported per-hit ApplyExternalStrain/ApplyInternalStrain, anchoring setters, breaking/piece velocity APIs, SetRestCollection, damage thresholds and damage propagation controls exist. Strain radius tests piece centers of mass; ItemIndex is from HitResult.

SetRestCollection resets the dynamic collection and recreates physics state; per-piece damage and anchoring commands only forward when PhysicsProxy exists. Configure before registration and do not use anchor calls before physics exists.

GetGeometryCollection/SetGeometryCollection and invalidation exist; CreateSimulationData, CreateSimulationDataIfNeeded and RebuildRenderData are WITH_EDITOR. UpdateGeometryDependentProperties updates proximity, convex hulls, volume and size.
CreateMeshSection_LinearColor supports collision. UpdateMeshSection_LinearColor preserves topology and updates collision; bUseComplexAsSimpleCollision and bUseAsyncCooking are available.

LinearColor update forwards to UpdateMeshSection. With the same vertex count and collision enabled, the implementation gathers all collidable section vertices on the component and calls BodyInstance.UpdateTriMeshVertices. Async cooking is a separate creation/rebuild path, not proof that vertex updates are asynchronous.

Epic's editor cutter constructs FVoronoiDiagram and FPlanarCells and calls exported CutMultipleWithPlanarCells. This establishes a concrete native offline-fracture mechanism without private-editor-tool reflection.
FGeometryCollectionEngineConversion exports AppendMeshDescription and AppendStaticMesh. Include GeometryCollection/GeometryCollectionEngineConversion.h; module GeometryCollectionEngine.

implementation_evidence.finding: The relevant conversion bodies are WITH_EDITORONLY_DATA guarded. An exported declaration in a runtime module is not evidence of usable packaged-runtime mesh-to-collection authoring.

evidence.finding: Chaos::Facades::FCollectionAnchoringFacade exports AddAnchoredAttribute, SetAnchored(index or array, bool), SetInitialDynamicState and IsAnchored. Module Chaos; include GeometryCollection/Facades/CollectionAnchoringFacade.h. DefineSchema is empty, so explicitly add the Anchored attribute before setting it.

implementation_evidence.finding: Anchored is a transform-group attribute; AddAnchoredAttribute initializes false. IsValid also requires InitialDynamicState, so test the specific attribute preconditions rather than assuming the empty DefineSchema creates everything.

evidence.finding: FGeometryCollectionClusteringUtility exports ClusterBonesUnderNewNode, ClusterBonesUnderNewNodeWithParent, ClusterAllBonesUnderNewRoot and UpdateHierarchyLevelOfChildren. Module Chaos; include GeometryCollection/GeometryCollectionClusteringUtility.h. The root helper describes flattening existing bones; do not call it after authoring the desired nested hierarchy.
FGeometryCollectionProximityUtility(FGeometryCollection*) and UpdateProximity are exported by Chaos; include GeometryCollection/GeometryCollectionProximityUtility.h.

FPlanarCells can be constructed from sites and FVoronoiDiagram. CutMultipleWithPlanarCells takes cells, collection, transform selection, grout, collision sample spacing, random seed and optional transform/material/island settings; returns first new geometry index or -1 when none was added. Module PlanarCut; include PlanarCut.h.

implementation_evidence.finding: Dependencies include Voronoi, GeometryCore, DynamicMesh, Chaos, GeometryAlgorithms and MeshDescription. PlanarCut.uplugin declares module PlanarCut as Runtime and the plugin as Beta; this contract deliberately uses it only in editor authoring.

evidence.finding: FVoronoiDiagram(Sites, Bounds, ExtraBoundingSpace, SquaredDistSkipPtThreshold) is exported. Module Voronoi; include Voronoi/Voronoi.h.

Runtime anchor index means authored transform index, not an arbitrary Hit.Item; native code indexes FromTransformToParticleIndex and updates top-parent kinematic properties. ApplyExternalStrain operates on nearby cluster children and always chooses the closest child if the radius finds none. Noncluster targets are acted on directly. External strain is max-combined, not automatically summed; positive ApplyInternalStrain reduces internal strain, clamped at zero. These commands enqueue from the game thread.

FGeometryCollectionDamagePropagationData has bEnabled, BreakDamagePropagationFactor and ShockDamagePropagationFactor. Defaults include break propagation factor 1, so explicitly override locality settings rather than inheriting an accidental cascade.

URadialFalloff::SetRadialFalloff(Magnitude, MinRange, MaxRange, Default, Radius, Position, Falloff), URadialVector::SetRadialVector, UOperatorField::SetOperatorField and UCullingField::SetCullingField are available. Use Default=0 outside the radius and multiply the scalar falloff by the radial vector. Include Field/FieldSystemObjects.h; module FieldSystemEngine.
UGeometryCollectionComponent::ApplyPhysicsField takes EGeometryCollectionPhysicsTypeEnum, unlike UFieldSystemComponent which takes EFieldPhysicsType.

implementation_evidence.finding: The component creates a transient command and buffers it on its own PhysicsProxy, a concrete per-collection route instead of a global master field.

evidence.finding: EGeometryCollectionPhysicsTypeEnum includes Chaos_ExternalClusterStrain, Chaos_LinearForce, Chaos_LinearVelocity and Chaos_LinearImpulse, with explicit mappings to EFieldPhysicsType. Module Chaos; include GeometryCollection/GeometryCollectionSimulationTypes.h. Core field types live under Chaos/Public/Field/FieldSystemTypes.h in this installation.

UFieldSystemComponent exports ApplyStrainField, ApplyPhysicsField and AddFieldCommand. ApplyRadialForce has magnitude and position but no radius argument; it is not the bounded impact API to use here. Initialization fields are a separate construction path.

UDynamicMeshComponent exports SetMesh, EditMesh, SetComplexAsSimpleCollisionEnabled, SetDeferredCollisionUpdatesEnabled and UpdateCollision(bool bOnlyIfPending=true); bUseAsyncCooking is available and explicitly suitable when collision need not be immediately current. Module GeometryFramework, mesh types GeometryCore; include Components/DynamicMeshComponent.h.
UNiagaraFunctionLibrary::SpawnSystemAtLocation supports bAutoActivate, ENCPoolMethod and bPreCullCheck. Include NiagaraFunctionLibrary.h; module Niagara.

UNiagaraComponent exports ReleaseToPool, Activate, DeactivateImmediate, SetAsset, SetSystemFixedBounds, SetVariableVec3, SetVariablePosition and SetVariableFloat. World-position parameters have a distinct large-world-aware setter. Include NiagaraComponent.h; module Niagara.

UWaterBodyComponent::TryQueryWaterInfoClosestToWorldLocation returns TValueOrError and replaces the deprecated query; GetWaterSurfaceInfoAtLocation returns bool with surface, normal, velocity and optional depth outputs. Handle failure explicitly. Module Water; include WaterBodyComponent.h.
UWaterWavesBase supplies height/normal queries; UWaterWavesAsset::SetWaterWaves changes wave-model data. These methods are not, by themselves, proof of impact-driven, conservative fluid simulation.

UShallowWaterSubsystem is abstract and exports InitializeShallowWater, IsShallowWaterInitialized, RegisterImpact(FVector ImpactPosition, FVector ImpactVelocity, float ImpactRadius), SetWaterBodyMIDParameters, GetGridSize and GetGridResolution. A concrete UBasicShallowWaterSubsystem exists. Module WaterAdvanced; include ShallowWaterSubsystem.h and BasicShallowWaterSubsystem.h.

implementation_evidence.finding: RegisterImpact silently returns without its Niagara simulation or an AWaterBody found by a +/-10 cm vertical trace on GetImpactCollisionChannel (default ECC_WorldDynamic). Inactive simulations queue impacts; WriteImpactToNDC writes Position, Velocity and Radius but returns without its configured data channel. The void call is not a success acknowledgement.

evidence.finding: UShallowWaterSettings requires configured simulation, collision Niagara Data Channel and material parameter assets; exposes ShallowWaterSimParameters and limits. UseDefaultShallowWaterSubsystem defaults false.

implementation_evidence.finding: Concrete subsystem creation/initialization checks UseDefaultShallowWaterSubsystem. WaterAdvanced.uplugin lines 12-36 declares Experimental, disabled by default, Runtime module and Niagara/NiagaraFluids/Water plugin dependencies.

evidence.finding: GeometryCollectionEngine sets physics support, depends publicly on FieldSystemEngine and adds UnrealEd only for editor targets. FieldSystemEngine.Build.cs lines 5-24 explicitly depends on Chaos, ChaosSolverEngine and PhysicsCore. Do not copy obsolete GeometryCollectionCore or FieldSystemCore module lists into this 5.8 project without verifying them.

evidence.title: Dataflow for Destruction Quickstart
evidence.finding: Epic documents static mesh conversion, scatter, Voronoi fracture, clustering, terminal output and local Hit.Item strain/velocity wiring. This proves the authoring workflow, not the capabilities of the parent's typed MCP tools.

evidence.title: Destruction Overview
evidence.finding: Geometry Collections use prefractured geometry, clustering, connectivity and strain; caches are a replay optimization, not unrestricted interactive destruction.

evidence.title: UProceduralMeshComponent
evidence.finding: Official API corroborates custom triangles, collision, section creation/update and async cooking; the component carries an Experimental warning. Exact 5.8 collision-update behavior is established by N05.

evidence.title: Fluid Simulation Overview
evidence.finding: Epic distinguishes shallow-water surface heightfields from splash-oriented 2D FLIP and more expensive 3D liquids. This supports separate local wave/pooling simulation and visual plumes, not full-river CFD.

evidence.title: UShallowWaterSubsystem
evidence.finding: Official 5.8 API corroborates RegisterImpact, concrete subclass, grid queries and water material setup.

evidence.title: Simulating Waves Using The Water Waves Asset
evidence.finding: Water Waves documents a Gerstner model and extensibility. Macro wave rendering does not itself establish local impact response, bathymetry updates or retained water volume.

evidence.title: Scalability and Best Practices for Niagara
evidence.finding: Use pooling, controlled instance/emitter counts, bounds and measured GPU/CPU choices; GPU particle simulation still has CPU system/emitter overhead.

evidence.title: Performance Budgeting Using Effect Types
evidence.finding: Effect Types support budget-, distance- and instance-based scalability.

evidence.title: Measuring Performance in Niagara
evidence.finding: Measure representative gameplay and simultaneous instances, not isolated effects; supports Unreal Insights based acceptance rather than a hardware-only frame-rate promise.

evidence.title: UProjectileMovementComponent
evidence.finding: Official 5.8 API documents gravity scale, world/local initial velocity, swept movement, substeps, GetGravityZ, ComputeMoveDelta and StopSimulating. Header Engine\Source\Runtime\Engine\Classes\GameFramework\ProjectileMovementComponent.h, module Engine. Only web evidence used here; no flight source or additional Engine-module native source inspected.

verified_direction.buildings: Create and cook closed, prefractured Geometry Collections offline/editor-side. Runtime uses UGeometryCollectionComponent and bounded hit/field commands; it does not manufacture cooked fracture data during play.
verified_direction.terrain: One ProceduralMesh component per small terrain chunk, one collision section per component, fixed vertex/index topology. Precreate collision before gameplay; deform vertices and use UpdateMeshSection_LinearColor. All-positions collision gathering is why a city-wide component is unsuitable.
important_caveats: Do not call SetRestCollection on an already damaged live building as a routine update; it resets its dynamic state.
Anchor calls before PhysicsProxy creation can silently do nothing; prefer anchors authored into the asset.
Local hit damage uses center-of-mass radius sampling, not exact clipping of a blast sphere against mesh triangles.
bUseAsyncCooking does not move every terrain vertex update off the game thread.
Header/source evidence establishes feasibility, not successful packaging or performance.

open_risks: Installed 5.8 native APIs and editor fracture export/build boundaries still to verify.
No runtime behavior or performance has been measured in this research-only task.
